message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "Update flake inputs"
on:
  workflow_dispatch: # allows manual triggering
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 0" # runs weekly on Sunday at 00:00

jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v30
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN_FOR_UPDATES }}
      - uses: cachix/cachix-action@v15
        with:
          name: horriblename
          authToken: "${{ secrets.CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN }}"
      - name: Update flake.lock
        uses: DeterminateSystems/update-flake-lock@v23
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN_FOR_UPDATES }}
          pr-title: "Update flake.lock" # Title of PR to be created
          pr-labels: | # Labels to be set on the PR
            dependencies
            automated
      - name: build and test hyprgrass
        run: |
          nix build .#hyprgrassWithTests \
          --option extra-substituters https://hyprland.cachix.org \
          --option extra-trusted-public-keys hyprland.cachix.org-1:a7pgxzMz7+chwVL3/pzj6jIBMioiJM7ypFP8PwtkuGc=",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a weekly scheduled job whose purpose is to check external flake inputs for updates, so schedule-suppression optimizations are contraindicated: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE explicitly excludes cases where external dependencies need fresh checks, and P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE requires an approved monitored pause/resume policy that is not present. There is no matrix to fail-fast and no change-path filtering applies to a schedule-driven update job. The applicable, evidence-supported optimization is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: bound the job with an explicit timeout to prevent runaway consumption. CI history shows successful runs complete in about 1-2 minutes, so a 30-minute budget gives ample operational headroom without affecting valid runs or build/test coverage. The change adds no permissions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
